200.title: Polish President to headline PH-Poland IT summit
200.summary: Business Education FinTech E-commerce Embassy News Innovation Investment Technology Polish President to headline PH-Poland IT summit By Monsi A.
200.body: Business Education FinTech E-commerce Embassy News Innovation Investment Technology Polish President to headline PH-Poland IT summit By Monsi A. Serrano The Philippines and Poland are set to further deepen technology and business cooperation as Polish President Karol Nawrocki joins the fifth Poland–Philippines IT Business Summit in Makati City early October, bringing together government, business, and technology leaders from both countries. The summit is organized by the Polish Investment and Trade Agency (PAIH), the Embassy of Poland in Manila, and Spiderhook Inc., with iACADEMY as academic partner and host. PAIH, Poland’s government trade and investment promotion agency, supports Polish companies seeking business partners in the Philippines while facilitating opportunities for Philippine businesses in Poland.

200.summary: Speaker of Polish parliament signs off on service dog’s retirement after eight years of “exemplary” service Sep 30, 2026 | Notes from Pawland Keep our news free from ads and paywalls by making a donation to support our work!
200.body: Speaker of Polish parliament signs off on service dog’s retirement after eight years of “exemplary” service Sep 30, 2026 | Notes from Pawland Keep our news free from ads and paywalls by making a donation to support our work! After eight years of service, Cobra, one of the first dogs to serve in the security force of Poland’s parliament, has retired. Czuwają nad bezpieczeństwem wszystkich osób w gmachach pozostających w zarządzie… pic.twitter.com/dKRvHOlKxe — Sejm RP🇵🇱 (@KancelariaSejmu) September 30, 2026 On a more serious note, the Sejm pointed to the vital role played by dogs in the so-called Speaker’s Guard (Straż Marszałkowska), which is responsible for security in parliament. “They watch over the safety of all people in the buildings managed by the chancellery of the Sejm,” they wrote, thanking Cobra for eight years of “exemplary” service and wishing her well on her “well-deserved retirement”.

200.body: The Trump administration has excluded several major allies, including Britain, France and the Baltic states, from a Pentagon-led NATO meeting in Poland next month, Politico reported, citing six diplomats familiar with the planning. Excluded allies seek answers on NATO meeting "We're doing everything that is being asked of us," an official from an excluded ally told Politico. The NATO meeting in Poland is expected next month.

300.title: Poland's PM Donald Tusk set to visit India with 100 firms in late October: Finance Minister Andrzej Domański
300.summary: Speaking to ANI on the sidelines of the G20 Trade Ministers' Meeting in Milwaukee, Wisconsin, on Wednesday (local time), Polish Minister of Finance and Economy Andrzej Domański detailed the preparations for the high-profile diplomatic visit scheduled for late October. Prime Minister Modi also extended an invitation to Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk to visit India, following Tusk's previous visit to the country in 2010.
300.body: Speaking to ANI on the sidelines of the G20 Trade Ministers' Meeting in Milwaukee, Wisconsin, on Wednesday (local time), Polish Minister of Finance and Economy Andrzej Domański detailed the preparations for the high-profile diplomatic visit scheduled for late October. "We were discussing Prime Minister Donald Tusk's visit to India, which will take place in late October. This upcoming diplomatic engagement builds upon strong foundations established when India and Poland elevated their diplomatic ties to a Strategic Partnership during Prime Minister Narendra Modi's landmark visit to Warsaw in August 2024, marking the first visit by an Indian premier to the European nation in 45 years. Prime Minister Modi also extended an invitation to Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk to visit India, following Tusk's previous visit to the country in 2010.

300.title: Inbank responds to Poland's competition watchdog decision to fine the company PLN 4.6 million
300.summary: Payments News Inbank responds to Poland’s competition watchdog decision to fine the company PLN 4.6 million Maria Nikolova 0 Comments September 30, 2026 Inbank today published its response to a decision by the Polish Office of Competition and Consumer Protection (UOKiK) to fine the company PLN 4.6 million.
300.body: Payments News Inbank responds to Poland’s competition watchdog decision to fine the company PLN 4.6 million Maria Nikolova 0 Comments September 30, 2026 Inbank today published its response to a decision by the Polish Office of Competition and Consumer Protection (UOKiK) to fine the company PLN 4.6 million. The company stated: “Inbank has taken the matters raised by UOKiK seriously but disagrees with some of the conclusions reached by the authority and is planning to appeal the decision. UOKiK’s decision is not final or immediately enforceable, and Inbank has 30 days to file an appeal. Inbank remains committed to ensuring that its practices comply with applicable consumer protection requirements.” Inbank is a financial technology company with an EU banking license that connects merchants, consumers and financial institutions on its next generation embedded finance platform.

400.body: Home DSR Battery & storage technology Greenvolt and Statkraft sign agreement for the management of 400MW of battery... The agreement is the largest publicly communicated in the EU to date* and marks Statkraft’s first large-scale BESS contract in the Polish market. The structure of a tolling agreement gives Statkraft the right to decide when the batteries charge and discharge across energy and flexibility markets, while giving Greenvolt an additional source of predictable, long-term revenue alongside the revenue already secured through Poland’s Capacity Market. Having previously signed Poland’s largest cPPA and first subsidy-free utility-based solar PPA, we are proud to add another landmark transaction,” says Kornel Koronowski, Head of Origination Poland, Statkraft.

500.title: Google Launches Gemini 4 Argon With Guardrail-Free Access for Vetted Defenders
500.summary: Artificial Intelligence Google Launches Gemini 4 Argon With Guardrail-Free Access for Vetted Defenders The company says its new frontier AI model found a critical vulnerability in software used by hospitals worldwide.
500.body: Artificial Intelligence Google Launches Gemini 4 Argon With Guardrail-Free Access for Vetted Defenders The company says its new frontier AI model found a critical vulnerability in software used by hospitals worldwide. By Eduard Kovacs | October 1, 2026 (3:52 AM ET) Flipboard Reddit Whatsapp Whatsapp Email Google on Wednesday announced Gemini 4 Argon, its new frontier AI model, which it is initially rolling out to a select group of trusted cyber defenders through its Fairwind Program. “For trusted defenders and our own internal teams at Google, we’ll be releasing Argon without cyber guardrails so they can leverage its full frontier-level cybersecurity defense capabilities,” the company said. Google says Argon found a flaw in hospital software Wiz, which Google acquired earlier this year, is using Argon in its Scan for Good initiative, which finds and remediates high-risk exposures in critical public infrastructure for free.
